rows.reason: The composite TGA curve or residue is predicted by externally specified mass-balance weighting of independently measured pure-component TGA data using the known MXene mass fraction, without fitting to the composite measurements.
The external thin-film shielding law uses independently obtained conductivity and thickness to predict VNA-measured EMI shielding effectiveness without fitting to or reusing the target measurement.
The shielding efficiency was directly computed by the authors from the measured total EMI shielding effectiveness using the stated formula.

The target SSE/t was explicitly calculated by the authors from the measured total shielding effectiveness and film thickness (with density as used in their definition), so the relation only reproduces their arithmetic.
